stories.title: US designates Palestine Action as a terrorist organisation
stories.summary: US designates Palestine Action as a terrorist organisation The US has imposed sanctions on the direct action group Palestine Action, designating it a Specially Designated ​Global Terrorist, according ​to a notice posted on ⁠a Treasury Department website. According to the Telegraph, US officials say that the group's promotion of "acts of terrorism" on social media encourages others to adopt direct action tactics overseas, including in the US. This marks the first known case of a British left-wing group being subjected to US counter-terrorism sanctions. The sanctions will see the group's assets in the US frozen and Americans barred from doing business with them. According to the Telegraph

article_sentences: Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei was seriously wounded in strikes on Iran but survived, US President Donald Trump said in an interview with conservative radio host Glenn Beck.
The left side of his body, the arm, the leg, the whole thing.

stories.headline: 2 arrested in Hong Kong fight over elderly woman slapping girl

opening: Hong Kong police have arrested two women on suspicion of assault at a shopping centre in Kwun Tong, with a viral clip showing a fight breaking out after a five-year-old girl was shoved and then knocked to the ground.
The fight took place at the atrium of the APM shopping centre at around 4.45pm on Wednesday as a crowd of parents and young children gathered around a play area.
body: A source said one of the suspects, aged 68, was visiting the play area with her 34-year-old daughter and grandson.

stories.title: Bank of Russia lowers dollar exchange rate to 84.28 rubles for August 27
stories.summary: The official euro exchange rate has been lowered by 22.85 kopecks to 98.2897 rubles
article_sentences: The Bank of Russia has set the official dollar exchange rate at 84.282 rubles for August 27, 2026, which is 18.15 kopecks higher than the previous indicator.
The official euro exchange rate has been lowered by 22.85 kopecks to 98.2897 rubles.
The official yuan exchange rate has been lowered by 3.65 kopecks to 12.5294 rubles.
